title: 第九章 第一滴血
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

凌晨三点十七分，东哨塔上的对讲机响了。

“林哥。”大刘的声音压得极低，像是用气声在说话，“国道方向，有东西在移动。不是人。”

林越从浅眠中睁开眼睛。他靠在冷库二楼的墙上，身上盖着一件工装外套，对讲机就放在耳边。从闭上眼睛到完全清醒，他只用了三秒钟。这是他前世五年刻进骨头里的本能——睡眠再深，只要哨兵一句话，意识就能立刻浮上来，不带任何过渡。

他抓起对讲机：“数量，距离，方向。”

“目测十几只，不到二十。距离大概四百米，从国道往我们这个方向来。移动速度不快，但走路的姿势——”大刘顿了一下，声音又压低了一点，“绝对不是人。腿不打弯，有的在拖，有一只在地上爬，爬得比走的还快。”

林越站起来，工装外套从身上滑落。“所有人，战斗岗位。非战斗人员全部进三号冷库，锁门。赵铭、陆寒霜，正门集合。”

冷库里响起脚步声。苏沐晴和钟国维从折叠桌旁站起来，桌面上的病毒模型图表被快速卷起。赵德柱从角落的椅子上起身，把怀里的相框重新用旧衣服裹紧，抱在胸前朝最里面的三号冷库走去。王浩从配电房跑出来，手里还拎着一块拆下来的柴油机滤清器，在楼梯口和林越撞了个照面。

“柴油机要不要停？”王浩问。

“不停。你把配电房的门锁死，进三号冷库。没有我的命令不准出来。”

“可是电机还在磨合期，我本来打算——”

“进去。”林越按住他的肩膀，手上用了点力，“电机坏了可以修。人死了修不了。”

王浩张了张嘴，最终只点了下头，把滤清器往口袋里一塞，转身朝三号冷库跑去。他跑起来的姿势有些笨拙，但速度不慢。林越看着他的背影消失在冷库走廊尽头，才转身下楼。

正门后面，陆寒霜已经到了。她站在铁门右侧的阴影里，手里握着一把半自动步枪，枪管在冷库照明灯的冷白光下泛着乌色。她已经在枪口拧上了***——那***林越昨晚没见过，是她今天凌晨从装备箱里翻出来的私人物品。赵铭从另一个方向跑过来，手里拎着那把磨了刃的工兵铲和一件防弹背心。

“穿上。”赵铭把防弹背心塞到林越怀里。

林越套上背心，拉紧魔术贴，从腰间拔出工兵铲。铲刃是赵铭前天晚上磨过的，刃口在灯光下折出一道细细的寒光。他看了一眼铲刃，然后按下对讲机：“大刘，实时位置。”

“距离大概三百米。还在往这边走。速度比刚才快了一点——等等，领头的那只停了一下，歪着头，好像——”大刘的声音忽然顿住，过了三秒才继续，“柴油机。它们听到了柴油机的声音。领头那只偏头的方向正好对着配电房。”

陆寒霜已经伸手去推铁门的门栓了。

“王浩，”林越按下对讲机，“把柴油机的隔音棉全部盖上，排气管转向背面。做完立刻进冷库，十秒。”

对讲机里传来王浩跑动的脚步声和金属碰撞的闷响，然后是铁门关闭的声音。

“两百米。”大刘的声音更低了，“我看到它们的脸了。灰色的，嘴唇没了，牙齿全部露在外面。有一只走路的时候腿是反折的，但它走得比其他的都快——林哥，是不是你之前说过的变异体？”

“舔食者。”林越说。

站在他旁边的赵铭看到林越握工兵铲的手指猛地收紧了。不是恐惧，是某种更深的东西。那种只有在面对一个前世杀过你三个队友的怪物时才会有的本能反应。

“大刘，不要开枪。等它们到门口。哨塔保持静默。”

“明白。”

林越转向赵铭和陆寒霜：“外面大概十七只。一只舔食者，其余是普通丧尸。我们要在围墙外面解决。不能用枪——枪声在夜里能传三公里，打死十几只，引来几百只。这些只是零散游荡过来的，不是尸潮。”

陆寒霜已经把步枪背到了身后，从腰间拔出一把匕首。刀身哑光黑，在灯光下几乎不反光。她试了一下刀鞘的松紧，然后反握匕首，动作流畅得像是拧开水龙头。

“近身格杀。”她说，“普通丧尸的致命点只有一个——脑干。脖子后面，枕骨下方，颈椎第三节和第四节之间。斜着往上捅，进去三公分就够。正面的话从太阳穴平推进去，角度不能偏，偏了会卡在颅骨上。别砍脖子，砍掉头身体还会动，咬合力能维持好几分钟。”

赵铭看着她，默默地把工兵铲换到左手，从腰间拔出户外匕首。

林越推开正门旁边的小铁门。那是围墙工程中预留的单人出入口，位置隐蔽，从外面看不到。三个人鱼贯而出。

外面的夜风比刚才更大了，带着浓烈的焦糊味和另一种味道——腐败血肉混合着排泄物的甜腥臭。那是丧尸的味道。林越的鼻腔像是被激活了某种远古的记忆开关，全身的汗毛竖起来又落下去。不是恐惧，是确认。就是这个味道。他闻了五年，死后重生以为自己再也不用闻了，但此刻闻到的时候他心里只有一个念头——终于来了。

他们贴着围墙外侧的阴影移动。头顶的铁丝网在微弱的火光映照下像是某种食肉植物的棘刺，铁丝末端的毛刺闪着细碎的寒芒。前方八十米，一群模糊的黑影正朝这边拖行过来。它们走路的姿态没有任何生命的美感——那是被某种东西操控着的行尸走肉，每一步都是对“行走”这个词本身的亵渎。领头的那只走得最快，四肢着地，脊椎反弓，惨白的皮肤紧紧裹着嶙峋的骨骼，像一只被剥了皮又被重新拼起来的壁虎。

舔食者。

林越前世杀过十一只舔食者。每一只都记得。第三只在城北地下停车场，咬掉了他身边一个队员的半个肩膀，那个人叫孙胜，死的时候还在扣扳机。第七只在废弃医院太平间门口，他用消防斧把它钉在墙上，斧刃卡在脊椎骨里拔不出来，他徒手又杀了三只普通丧尸才回头取斧。第十一只——是和尸王同归于尽之前杀的，他把最后一颗手雷塞进了它的嘴里，爆炸的冲击波把他自己掀飞出去五米。

“我做主攻。”林越说，声音低到几乎只有唇语，“陆寒霜，右边那只瘸腿的普通丧尸。赵铭，左边那只走得最慢的。舔食者留给我。”

没有人质疑。陆寒霜和赵铭一左一右散开，身影融入围墙阴影的边缘。

Page (1/3)

At 3:17 in the morning, the intercom on the east watchtower rang.

"Brother Lin." Da Liu's voice was very low, as if he was speaking breathlessly, "There is something moving in the direction of the national highway. It's not a person."

Lin Yue opened his eyes from his light sleep.He leaned against the wall on the second floor of the cold storage, covered with a work coat, and put the walkie-talkie to his ear.It only took him three seconds from closing his eyes to fully waking up.This was an instinct engraved into his bones during the five years of his previous life - no matter how deeply he slept, as long as the sentry said a word, his consciousness would immediately surface without any transition.

He grabbed the walkie-talkie: "Quantity, distance, direction."

"Visually there are more than a dozen, less than twenty. The distance is about 400 meters, coming from the national highway in our direction. The movement speed is not fast, but the walking posture -" Liu paused and lowered his voice a little, "They are definitely not human. The legs are not bent, some are dragging, and one is crawling on the ground, crawling faster than walking."

Lin Yue stood up, his work jacket slipping off his body."Everyone, combat positions. All non-combatants enter Cold Storage No. 3 and lock the door. Zhao Ming and Lu Hanshuang gather at the main entrance."

Footsteps sounded in the cold storage.Su Muqing and Zhong Guowei stood up from the folding table, and the virus model chart on the table was quickly rolled up.Zhao Dezhu stood up from the chair in the corner, wrapped the photo frame in his arms tightly with old clothes, held it against his chest and walked towards the innermost cold storage No. 3.Wang Hao ran out of the power distribution room, carrying a removed diesel filter in his hand, and bumped into Lin Yue at the top of the stairs.

"Do you want to stop the diesel engine?" Wang Hao asked.

"Don't stop. Lock the door of the power distribution room and enter cold storage No. 3. You are not allowed to come out without my order."

"But the motor is still in the running-in period, I originally planned to-"

"Go in." Lin Yue held his shoulders and used some force on his hands. "If the motor is broken, it can be repaired. If a person is dead, it cannot be repaired."

Wang Hao opened his mouth, but finally nodded, stuffed the filter into his pocket, turned around and ran towards Cold Storage No. 3.His running posture was a bit awkward, but his speed was not slow.Lin Yue watched his back disappear at the end of the cold storage corridor before turning and going downstairs.

Behind the main entrance, Lu Hanshuang has arrived.She stood in the shadow on the right side of the iron door, holding a semi-automatic rifle in her hand. The barrel of the gun glowed black under the cold white light of the cold storage lighting.She had already screwed the gun on the gun - that gun Lin Yue had not seen last night. It was a personal belonging that she dug out of the equipment box early this morning.Zhao Ming ran over from the other direction, carrying the sharpened engineer shovel and a bulletproof vest.

"Put it on." Zhao Ming stuffed the bulletproof vest into Lin Yue's arms.

Lin Yue put on his vest, tightened the Velcro, and pulled out the engineering shovel from his waist.The shovel blade was sharpened by Zhao Ming the night before yesterday, and the blade gave off a thin cold light under the light.He glanced at the blade, then pressed the intercom: "Da Liu, real-time location."

"The distance is about three hundred meters. Still walking this way. The speed is a little faster than before - wait, the leading one stopped for a moment and tilted its head, as if -" Liu's voice suddenly paused, and after three seconds he continued, "Diesel engine. They heard the sound of the diesel engine. The direction of the leading one's head is facing the power distribution room."

Lu Hanshuang had already reached out to push the bolt of the iron door.

"Wang Hao," Lin Yue pressed the intercom, "cover all the soundproofing cotton on the diesel engine and turn the exhaust pipe to the back. Once done, immediately enter the cold storage for ten seconds."

The sound of Wang Hao's running footsteps and the muffled sound of metal colliding came from the intercom, and then the sound of the iron door closing.

"Two hundred meters." Da Liu's voice became even lower. "I saw their faces. They were gray, with no lips and all the teeth exposed. One of them walked with folded legs, but it walked faster than the others - Brother Lin, is it the mutant you mentioned before?"

"Licker." Lin Yue said.

Zhao Ming, who was standing next to him, saw Lin Yue's fingers tightening on the engineer shovel.Not fear, something deeper.The kind of instinctive reaction you only have when facing a monster that killed three of your teammates in a previous life.

"Da Liu, don't shoot. Wait for them to come to the door. Keep the guard tower silent."

"Understood."

Lin Yue turned to Zhao Ming and Lu Hanshuang: "There are about seventeen of them outside. One licker and the rest are ordinary zombies. We have to deal with them outside the wall. We can't use guns - the sound of gunshots can travel three kilometers at night, killing a dozen of them and attracting hundreds of them. These are just scattered wanderings, not a tide of zombies."

Lu Hanshuang had already put the rifle behind his back and pulled out a dagger from his waist.The blade is matte black and barely reflects light under the light.She tested the tightness of the scabbard, then held the dagger behind her back, her movements as smooth as turning on a faucet.

"Kill at close range." She said, "Ordinary zombies have only one fatal point - the brainstem. Behind the neck, below the occipital bone, between the third and fourth cervical vertebrae. Stab upwards diagonally, and only three centimeters in is enough. If it is from the front, push it in from the temples, and the angle cannot be deviated, otherwise it will get stuck on the skull. Don't chop the neck, the body will still move after the head is chopped off, and the bite force can be maintained for several minutes."

Zhao Ming looked at her, silently shifted the engineering shovel to his left hand, and pulled out the outdoor dagger from his waist.

Lin Yue pushed open the small iron door next to the main entrance.It was a single entrance reserved in the wall project. It was located in a hidden location and could not be seen from the outside.Three people filed out.

The night wind outside was stronger than before, carrying a strong smell of burnt food and another smell - the sweet smell of rotting flesh and blood mixed with excrement.That's the smell of zombies.Lin Yue's nasal cavity seemed to have been activated by some ancient memory switch, and the hairs all over his body stood up and then fell down.Not fear, but validation.That's the taste.He had been smelling it for five years, and after death and rebirth, he thought he would never have to smell it again, but when he smelled it now, he only had one thought in his mind - it was finally here.

They moved against the shadows on the outside of the wall.The barbed wire above the head looked like the thorns of some kind of carnivorous plant under the weak firelight, and the burrs at the ends of the wire shone with a fine cold light.Eighty meters ahead, a group of blurry black figures were dragging towards this side.There is no beauty of life in their walking posture - they are walking zombies controlled by something, and every step is a blasphemy against the word "walking" itself.The leading one walked the fastest, lying on all fours, its spine arched, its pale skin tightly wrapped around its rugged bones, like a gecko that had been skinned and put back together again.

Licker.

Lin Yue killed eleven lickers in his previous life.Remember every one.The third one was in the underground parking lot in the north of the city and bit off half the shoulder of a team member next to him. The man's name was Sun Sheng, and he was still pulling the trigger when he died.The seventh one was at the entrance of the abandoned hospital morgue. He nailed it to the wall with a fire axe. The ax blade was stuck in his spine and could not be pulled out. He killed three more ordinary zombies with his bare hands before going back to get the axe.The eleventh one - he killed it before dying with the Corpse King. He stuffed the last grenade into its mouth, and the shock wave of the explosion blew him five meters away.

"I will be the main attacker." Lin Yue said, his voice so low that he could barely speak with his lips, "Lu Hanshuang, the lame ordinary zombie on the right. Zhao Ming, the slowest one on the left. Leave the licker to me."

No one questions it.Lu Hanshuang and Zhao Ming spread out to the left and right, their figures blending into the edge of the shadow of the wall.
